rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when explaining what words, signs, dreams, or actions mean.

example.english: Can you interpret what this symbol means?
example.traditional: 你可唔可以解釋下呢個符號係咩意思？
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gaai2 sik1 haa5 ne1 go3 fu4 hou2 hai6 me1 ji3 si1

rows.note: Use this specifically for conveying spoken or signed language between languages, especially in real time.

example.english: There will be a foreign guest at the meeting tomorrow, so please interpret for us.
example.traditional: 聽日個會有外國嘉賓，麻煩你幫手口譯。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 go3 wui6 jau5 ngoi6 gwok3 gaa1 ban1 maa4 faan4 nei5 bong1 sau2 hau2 jik6

rows.note: Use this when working out the meaning of a topic, text, sign, or other material rather than simply explaining it to someone.

example.english: We need to interpret the data in the report before deciding what to do next.
example.traditional: 我哋要先解讀份報告嘅數據，先決定下一步。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 gaai2 duk6 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 sin1 kyut3 ding6 haa6 jat1 bou6
